title: Honey Velvety Stir-Fry
description: A quick and easy stir-fry with velvety texture, sweet honey flavor, and a hint of savory goodness.

ingredients.name: Stir-fry vegetables
ingredients.notes: Mix of broccoli, bell peppers, carrots

instructions: Marinate the cubed tofu in a mixture of honey, soy sauce, and garlic for 10 minutes.
Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the stir-fry vegetables and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the marinated tofu and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
